kebab_example: aliyun vpc create-dhcp-options-set --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name-servers 192.XX.XX.123 --dhcp-options-set-name name --dhcp-options-set-description description --domain-name example.com --resource-group-id rg-acfmxazb4ph0000 --tag Value=FinanceJoshua Key=FinanceDept --client-token 0c593ea1-3bea-11e9-b96b-88e9fe637760 --dry-run false --lease-time 3650d --ipv6-lease-time 3650d --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDhcpOptionsSet

parameters.help_en:
The region in which the DHCP options set resides.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
DHCP选项集所在的地域。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The IP addresses of DNS servers. You can specify up to four DNS server IP addresses. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,).

If you do not specify DNS server IP addresses, ECS instances use the DNS server IP addresses provided by Alibaba Cloud (100.100.2.136 and 100.100.2.138) by default
parameters.help_zh:
DNS服务器IP。最多传入4个DNS服务器IP，DNS服务器IP之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。

未传入任何DNS服务器IP时，ECS实例默认使用阿里云提供的DNS服务器IP（100.100.2.136和100.100.2.138）
parameters.name: domain_name_servers

parameters.help_en:
The name of the DHCP options set.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or Chinese character. It can contain digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
DHCP选项集的名称。

长度为1～128个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: dhcp_options_set_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the DHCP options set. 

The description can be empty or 1 to 256 characters in length. It must start with a letter or Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
DHCP选项集的描述。 

描述可以为空或填写长度为1～256个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，但不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: dhcp_options_set_description

parameters.help_en:
The hostname suffix. Example: example.com.

After the DHCP options set is used to associate VPC, the hostname suffix is automatically synchronized to the ECS instances in the VPC
parameters.help_zh:
主机名后缀，例如example.com。

DHCP选项集关联VPC后，会自动将主机名后缀同步给VPC中ECS实例
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the DHCP options set belongs
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

A tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。最多支持输入20个标签键。如需传入该值，则不能输入空字符串。

一个标签键最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。最多支持输入20个标签值。如需传入该值，可以输入空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run. The system checks the required parameters, request syntax, and limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.

false (default): performs a dry run and sends the request. If the request passes the dry run, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the DHCP options set is created
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会创建DHCP选项集。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式和限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接创建DHCP选项集
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The lease time of the IPv4 DHCP options set.

If the lease time is in hours, the unit is h. Valid values: 24h to 1176h and 87600h to 175200h. Default value: 87600h.

If the lease time is in days, the unit is d. Valid values: 1d to 49d and 3650d to 7300d. Default value: 3650d.

You must include the unit when specifying the value
parameters.help_zh:
IPv4 DHCP选项集的租赁时间。

租赁时间设置为小时时：单位：h。取值范围：24h~1176h，87600h~175200h。   默认值：87600h。

租赁时间设置为天时：单位：d。取值范围： 1d~49d，3650d~7300d。   默认值：3650d 。

输入参数取值时，必须输入参数的单位
parameters.name: lease_time

parameters.help_en:
The lease time of the IPv6 DHCP options set.

If the lease time is in hours, the unit is h. Valid values: 24h to 1176h and 87600h to 175200h. Default value: 24h.

If the lease time is in days, the unit is d. Valid values: 1d to 49d and 3650d to 7300d. Default value: 1d.

You must include the unit when specifying the value
parameters.help_zh:
IPv6 DHCP选项集的租赁时间。

租赁时间设置为小时时：单位：h。取值范围：24h~1176h，87600h~175200h。   默认值：24h。

租赁时间设置为天时：单位：d。取值范围： 1d~49d，3650d~7300d。   默认值：1d 。

输入参数取值时，必须输入参数的单位
parameters.name: ipv6_lease_time
